# A persistent extension popup class carries the menu layout role

The landing applies webextension-menupopup to ordinary extension submenu construction, legacy toolbar-button popups and unified toolbar action popups. Current code retains those hooks and platform CSS uses the class independently of needsgutter. Proposed scoped pattern: share the same layout-role class across every builder of this popup family rather than depending on a transient attribute. The upstream reason stated in the commit was not independently read. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: WebExtension popup layout hooks.
